title: Urban Planning & Social Housing
goal: Build precise urban-policy clauses with prepositional relatives
grammar: prepositional relatives with el que, la que, los que and las que

items: I can keep verb-governed prepositions (*por*, *en*, *de*, *a*, *con*) before *el que / la que / los que / las que*.
I can match article gender, number and contractions like *del que* to abstract policy nouns.
I can use vocabulary for urban plans, zoning, social housing and habitability.
